text:
Lena (People Ops): Heads up — payroll exported this morning and I noticed Sofia Kim (ID 49502) was paid as a 1099 for the pay period 07/01-07/15 despite being converted to full-time on 07/05 in BambooHR. Can payroll investigate?
Ravi (Payroll): Thanks, Lena. Can you paste the payroll export line?
Lena (People Ops): Sure:
```
Period: 07/01-07/15
Employee: Sofia Kim (49502)
Gross: $3,200.00
Tax Withheld: $0.00
Net: $3,200.00
Paycode: CONTRACTOR_PAY
Deductions: $0.00
```
Owen (HRIS): I see the FT hire effective 2024-07-05 at 16:02. The employee_type field shows TRANSITION=FT but the nightly sync to payroll failed on 07/06 with a 502 and wasn't retried until 07/09. That likely caused the old paycode to be used.
Ravi (Payroll): Ok. Two things we need: 1) fix Sofia's worker type in payroll immediately so future runs are correct, 2) run an off-cycle to withhold the FT tax portion for 07/05-07/15, 3) decide how to handle benefit premiums since benefits open enrollment went through on 07/06 with effective 08/01.
Marta (Benefits): Because Sofia's benefits are effective 08/01, there is no retro premium to collect. But if company policy wants to provide pro-rated coverage back to 07/05 (some teams do), we need to approve and record ER cost.
Leah (Hiring Manager): We should not surprise Sofia with retro deductions. Suggest absorbing any small premium if we choose to backdate. Also let's check whether her health coverage start aligns with payroll dates.
Dana (Finance): For accounting I need exact tax withhold delta and employer-side taxes. Ravi, can you run a quick calc and send the numbers so I can record accruals?
Ravi (Payroll): Quick estimate: employee tax liability on the $3,200 for the FT portion (approx 11 days) is ~$700, employer taxes ~ $240. I'll run the tax engine for precise figures and post. Also I'll patch payroll record now so the next run uses FT paycode.
payroll-bot: Ticket created PR-2024-3290 (Sofia Kim - worker-type retro correction).
Owen (HRIS): I manually pushed the FT flag to payroll for Sofia and added a change note: "sync retry after 07/06 error; manual push 07/15 by HRIS". I'll follow up with Eng to add retry logic for 502s.
Ravi (Payroll): Calculations done: employee tax delta $704.00; employer tax delta $243.00. Since benefits effective 08/01, no benefit premium retroactive deduction.
Dana (Finance): Got it. I'll book accruals: Payroll liability $704, Employer payroll taxes $243 to payroll expense. Charge to department GL 6100.
Leah (Hiring Manager): Please draft a short DM for Sofia: explain there was a misclassification, we've corrected it, and no take-home pay will be reduced since we will not collect retroactive premiums. She should see an updated paystub in self-service.
Lena (People Ops): Draft DM: "Hi Sofia — we noticed your worker type didn't sync on 7/6 and you were paid as a contractor for part of July. We've corrected the payroll records and processed an off-cycle to record withholdings. We will not take any retroactive benefits deductions; your updated paystub is available in self-service. Let me know if you have questions." Approve?
Leah (Hiring Manager): Approved.
Ravi (Payroll): Off-cycle queued. I will not reduce Sofia's net pay (company absorbing employer taxes as usual); posting ETA 14:45 PT.
payroll-bot: Off-cycle posted for employee 49502; ticket PR-2024-3290; timestamp 1716154355.
Marta (Benefits): Noted — no retro premiums. I added reconciliation tag in Benefits admin.
Owen (HRIS): Added follow-up ticket to Engineering to add exponential retry and alerting on sync failures.
Dana (Finance): Recording accruals now. Please attach finalized off-cycle stub to PR-2024-3290 and CC finance.
Ravi (Payroll): Attached corrected stub to ticket and CCed finance and people-ops. Closing our side; re-open ticket if anything else appears.
Lena (People Ops): Thanks team. Closing loop — Sofia messaged back thanking us for handling it quickly.
